Project attribution

Review AD-400

The published reference

The supplied manufacturer brochure describes an AD-400 long-distance headrace water-tunnel inspection project associated with China Southern Power Grid.

The task

Access a flooded water tunnel for inspection and data collection over a long route.

The system

AD-400 vehicle, external tethered supply and a project-specific inspection package. The final sensors, tether management and position reference need to be checked against the original project record.

The reported outcome

For this development project, the manufacturer reports inspection inside a 5.5 km headrace tunnel, including 360-degree coverage, long-distance power and communication, and cruising capability. This is the brochure’s project statement, distinct from the 5 km maximum range on the current product webpage.

Applying this outside China

Owners of long headrace, diversion and water-transfer tunnels in other countries face the same constraint: inspecting kilometres of flooded tunnel without dewatering or diving. Use this reference to frame your own route, then compare its conditions with your tunnel profile, flow and access.

Evidence for a comparable project

  • Actual inspected route length and the vehicle version
  • Tunnel bends, flow, access and deployment conditions
  • Position referencing, coverage and data-quality criteria
  • Original footage, logs, recovery plan and acceptance record

What this reference establishes

The brochure identifies a relevant manufacturer application and a starting point for discussing the technical approach.

The available summary does not establish universal range, localization accuracy or suitability for every tunnel. Performance and transfer to a new site require the underlying project records.
